[[Agent/Legends|Agent]] '''Lesan Dos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|declaration]] of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], Dos was tasked with preventing anyone in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] from discovering the existence of the [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlacc]], a clandestine project that was undertaken by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]] to construct a [[Super Star Destroyer prototype|prototype]] [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]], and he exposed a number of anti-Imperial [[Alien/Legends|alien]] plots within the Senate, although anti-Imperial activists believed that Dos' findings were fabricated.

In about [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Dos commenced a sting operation in the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]], in the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], to try and draw out some of his non-Human enemies. While Dos' double, the ISB operative [[Nonul Weran]], visited the club and pretended to be Dos, Dos observed Weran from a balcony, to see if anyone approached the decoy. ISB agents were not normally permitted to visit the Outlander Club, but Dos blackmailed the establishment's owners into allowing him to perform his scheme, and the operation carried on for some time, with limited success. Shortly after the [[Battle of Nizon]], a team of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents traveled to club and defeated Dos and Weran in combat, then stole Dos' [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinder]] and used it to access [[Imeici Spire]], the headquarters of the Sarlacc Project.
